## Constraints

### Must

- Use the existing `--line-*` color tokens in both themes.
- Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Keep developer-facing labels compact and monospace.

### Avoid

- Decorative gradients and glass effects.
- Provider-logo grids in the CI section.
- Animations that continue while the section is offscreen.

## Decisions

- Represent CI automation with a full-column horizontal repository tree. Keep the topology stable, advance the active path every 2.8 seconds, and use only a subtle unblurred status-point breath.
- Apply the saved theme before first paint, keep the initial SSR and hydration language identical, and hold product content behind a centered line-tree boot mark until saved language and fonts have settled.
